items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I don't know where Cat was from originally.

ctx.x: -- Cat's time, yeah. Well, I'm a little older, yeah. I'll put it that way. But Cat might have played in one of those bands, but I didn't know him when he --
I wasn't sure about which -- the name of it, whether it was Jenkins or another one.
